question_text:
A $0.01-\mathrm{m}$-long bar of nickel is placed in a laboratory furnace and heated from room temperature $\left(25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ to $500^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. What will be the length of the bar at $500^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ ? (Take the coefficient of thermal expansion over this temperature range to be the average of the two values given in Table.) Give your answer as the value of length.
(Table:
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|c|}
\hline \multirow[b]{2}{*}{Material} & \multicolumn{3}{|c|}{$\alpha\left[\mathrm{mm} /\left(\mathrm{mm} \cdot{ }^{\circ} \mathbf{C}\right) \times 10^6\right]$} \\
\hline & Temperature $=27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}(300 \mathrm{~K})$ & $527^{\circ} \mathrm{C}(800 \mathrm{~K})$ & 0-1,000 ${ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ \\
\hline \multicolumn{4}{|l|}{Metals ${ }^{\text {a }}$} \\
\hline Aluminum & 23.2 & 33.8 & \\
\hline Copper & 16.8 & 20.0 & \\
\hline Gold & 14.1 & 16.5 & \\
\hline Nickel & 12.7 & 16.8 & \\
\hline Silver & 19.2 & 23.4 & \\
\hline Tungsten & 4.5 & 4.8 & \\
\hline \multicolumn{4}{|l|}{Ceramics and glasses ${ }^{\text {a,b }}$} \\
\hline Mullite ( $3 \mathrm{Al}_2 \mathrm{O}_3 \cdot 2 \mathrm{SiO}_2$ ) & & & 5.3 \\
\hline Porcelain & & & 6.0 \\
\hline Fireclay refractory & & & 5.5 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Al}_2 \mathrm{O}_3$ & & & 8.8 \\
\hline Spinel ( $\mathrm{MgO} \cdot \mathrm{Al}_2 \mathrm{O}_3$ ) & & & 7.6 \\
\hline MgO & & & 13.5 \\
\hline $\mathrm{UO}_2$ & & & 10.0 \\
\hline $\mathrm{ZrO}_2$ (stabilized) & & & 10.0 \\
\hline SiC & & & 4.7 \\
\hline Silica glass & & & 0.5 \\
\hline Soda-lime-silica glass & & & 9.0 \\
\hline \multicolumn{4}{|l|}{Polymers ${ }^{\text {a }}$} \\
\hline Nylon 66 & 30-31 & & \\
\hline Phenolic & 30-45 & & \\
\hline Polyethylene (high-density) & 149-301 & & \\
\hline Polypropylene & 68-104 & & \\
\hline Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) & 99 & & \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
)The unit of the answer is mm.
response:
## Step-by-step Reasoning

**Given:**
- Initial length: $L_0 = 0.01\ \text{m} = 10\ \text{mm}$
- Temperature change: $T_2 - T_1 = 500 - 25 = 475\ ^\circ\text{C}$
- Nickel coefficients from the table:
  - $\alpha_{27^\circ\text{C}} = 12.7 \times 10^{-6}\ /^\circ\text{C}$
  - $\alpha_{527^\circ\text{C}} = 16.8 \times 10^{-6}\ /^\circ\text{C}$

**Average coefficient of thermal expansion:**

$$\bar{\alpha} = \frac{12.7 + 16.8}{2}\times 10^{-6} = 14.75 \times 10^{-6}\ /^\circ\text{C}$$

**Thermal expansion:**

$$\Delta L = L_0\,\bar{\alpha}\,\Delta T = (10)(14.75\times10^{-6})(475) = 0.0700625\ \text{mm}$$

**Final length:**

$$L = L_0 + \Delta L = 10 + 0.0700625 = 10.0700625\ \text{mm}$$

$$\boxed{10.0700625}$$
